# Where it started

The rest of this site is about what I've made. This page is about where it started: a family that gave me things to take apart and put together, and a lot of sport before and alongside football.

::: {.sx-section #building}
<p class="sx-label">01 · Building things</p>

## A family of engineers

I come from a family of engineers, and my parents and grandparents gave me things to work out early: a keyboard before I could read, a toy car to assemble with my grandfather, a magnifying glass and some sunlight, a trip to see machines up close.

<p class="sx-more">Where this led: <a href="/projects/google-code-to-learn/index-en.html">my first app</a>, a <a href="/projects/vernacular-chatbot/index-en.html">multilingual voicebot</a>, an <a href="/projects/automated-trading/index-en.html">automated trading system</a> and <a href="/projects/systematick/index-en.html">Systematick</a>.</p>

::: {.sx-section #sport}
<p class="sx-label">02 · Sport</p>

## A footballer first, but not only a footballer

I have played sport for as long as I can remember. Football is the one I have stayed with: I have played it competitively since 2016. Before and alongside it came table tennis, chess, cricket, tennis, badminton, running and the Rubik's cube.

<div class="sx-block" id="football">
<div class="sx-block-head">
<h3>Football</h3>
<p class="sx-label">2016 – 2026</p>
<p>Boca Juniors academy, then Bangalore Premier Soccer School, then Bengaluru FC. Central midfielder and rotational captain with Young Blues Elite FC at U17 and U19, 2023 – 2026.</p>
</div>
